articles.title: Four hours of silence: what the nationwide ground stop reveals about America's aging air traffic control
articles.dek: Old switches and routers overloaded, officials say, halting every U.S. departure for more than four hours. Here is what happened, what auditors had warned, and the funding fight that follows.

pt.title: Quatro horas de silêncio: o que a suspensão nacional de voos revela sobre o controle aéreo envelhecido dos EUA
pt.dek: Switches e roteadores antigos ficaram sobrecarregados, dizem as autoridades, e todas as decolagens nos EUA pararam por mais de quatro horas. O que aconteceu, o que os auditores já tinham alertado e a disputa por verbas que vem a seguir.

de.title: Vier Stunden Stille: Was das landesweite Startverbot über die veraltete US-Flugsicherung verrät
de.dek: Alte Switches und Router seien überlastet gewesen, sagt die Regierung – mehr als vier Stunden lang startete in den USA kein Flug. Was geschah, wovor Prüfer gewarnt hatten und welcher Streit ums Geld nun folgt.

articles.title: The American Cancer Society now says men 50 to 69 should get PSA tests. Here is what changed
articles.dek: After 16 years of 'talk to your doctor', the society recommends a PSA test every two years, yearly from 45 for Black men and men with a strong family history, with new safeguards against overtreatment. The federal task force has not followed.

pt.title: A Sociedade Americana do Câncer agora diz que homens de 50 a 69 anos devem fazer o exame de PSA. Veja o que mudou
pt.dek: Depois de 16 anos de “converse com seu médico”, a entidade recomenda o PSA a cada dois anos, e anualmente a partir dos 45 para homens negros e com forte histórico familiar, com novas salvaguardas contra o excesso de tratamento. A força-tarefa federal não acompanhou.

de.title: Die American Cancer Society rät Männern zwischen 50 und 69 jetzt zum PSA-Test. Was sich geändert hat
de.dek: Nach 16 Jahren „Sprechen Sie mit Ihrem Arzt“ empfiehlt die Organisation einen PSA-Test alle zwei Jahre, für Schwarze Männer und Männer mit starker familiärer Vorbelastung jährlich ab 45, dazu neue Schutzmechanismen gegen Übertherapie. Die staatliche Expertenkommission zieht nicht mit.

articles.title: Iran war tech: the biggest Pentagon deals went to the smallest political spenders
articles.dek: A chart going around pairs the makers of the war's targeting software, drone defenses and AI models with the political money tied to them. Counted the same way for all six, the biggest contracts sit with the smallest givers, and the one contract cancelled was lost over terms of use, not money.

pt.title: Tecnologia da guerra no Irã: os maiores contratos do Pentágono foram para quem menos gastou em política
pt.dek: Um gráfico que circula compara os fabricantes do software de alvos, das defesas antidrone e dos modelos de IA da guerra com o dinheiro político ligado a eles. Contados do mesmo jeito para as seis, os maiores contratos estão com os menores doadores, e o único contrato cancelado foi perdido por condições de uso, não por dinheiro.

de.title: Die Technik des Iran-Kriegs: Die größten Pentagon-Aufträge gingen an die kleinsten politischen Spender
de.dek: Eine Grafik, die die Runde macht, stellt die Hersteller der Zielsoftware, Drohnenabwehr und KI-Modelle des Krieges dem politischen Geld gegenüber, das mit ihnen verbunden ist. Für alle sechs gleich gezählt, liegen die größten Verträge bei den kleinsten Spendern, und der einzige gekündigte Vertrag ging über Nutzungsbedingungen verloren, nicht über Geld.

articles.title: How a Democrat won Mississippi: Scott Colom's Senate upset, county by county, and the fight over 230,000 “inactive” voters
articles.dek: Scott Colom unseated Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by about 4,700 votes after an eight-day count. Here is how the suburbs swung, why affidavit ballots decided it, and what it means for a 55-seat Democratic Senate.

pt.title: Como um democrata venceu no Mississippi: a virada de Scott Colom no Senado, condado a condado, e a briga por 230 mil eleitores “inativos”
pt.dek: Scott Colom derrotou a senadora Cindy Hyde-Smith por cerca de 4.700 votos após oito dias de apuração. Veja como os subúrbios viraram, por que as cédulas provisórias decidiram a disputa e o que isso significa para um Senado com 55 democratas.

de.title: Wie ein Demokrat Mississippi gewann: Scott Colom und der Senatscoup, Bezirk für Bezirk, und der Streit um 230.000 „inaktive“ Wähler
de.dek: Scott Colom hat Senatorin Cindy Hyde-Smith nach acht Tagen Auszählung mit rund 4.700 Stimmen Vorsprung geschlagen. Wie die Vororte kippten, warum vorläufige Stimmzettel den Ausschlag gaben und was das für einen Senat mit 55 Demokraten bedeutet.

articles.title: Brazil hands the world a map out of fossil fuels. It binds no one, and Brazil is drilling more
articles.dek: At COP31 in Antalya, Brazil's COP30 team presented a voluntary roadmap that sorts countries by their dependence on coal, oil and gas and sets steps to 2033. Supporters call it a practical guide; skeptics point to Petrobras's record output.

pt.title: O Brasil entrega ao mundo um mapa para sair dos combustíveis fósseis. Ele não obriga ninguém, e o Brasil perfura mais
pt.dek: Na COP31, em Antália, a equipe brasileira da COP30 apresentou um roteiro voluntário que classifica os países por sua dependência de carvão, petróleo e gás e fixa etapas até 2033. Defensores o veem como guia prático; céticos apontam a produção recorde da Petrobras.

de.title: Brasilien legt der Welt einen Fahrplan aus Öl, Gas und Kohle vor. Er bindet niemanden, und Brasilien bohrt weiter
de.dek: Auf der COP31 in Antalya stellte Brasiliens COP30-Team einen freiwilligen Fahrplan vor, der Länder nach ihrer Abhängigkeit von Kohle, Öl und Gas einordnet und Schritte bis 2033 festlegt. Befürworter loben ihn als praktischen Leitfaden, Skeptiker verweisen auf die Rekordförderung von Petrobras.

articles.title: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for sabotaging 700 stores' fridges. Here is the case it made
articles.dek: Paris says an IRGC cyber unit heated cold cases across the country in October, causing fires and heavy losses. It wants EU sanctions and arrest warrants. The weak point was old, exposed controllers.

pt.title: França acusa a Guarda Revolucionária do Irã de sabotar as geladeiras de 700 lojas. Veja o caso que Paris apresentou
pt.dek: Paris diz que uma unidade cibernética da Guarda Revolucionária aqueceu balcões refrigerados em todo o país em outubro, provocando incêndios e grandes prejuízos. O governo quer sanções da UE e mandados de prisão. O ponto fraco eram controladores antigos e expostos.

de.title: Frankreich wirft Irans Revolutionsgarden Sabotage an den Kühlregalen von 700 Geschäften vor. So begründet Paris den Vorwurf
de.dek: Paris zufolge hat eine Cybereinheit der Revolutionsgarden im Oktober landesweit Kühltheken aufgeheizt, Brände und hohe Schäden verursacht. Frankreich will EU-Sanktionen und Haftbefehle. Die Schwachstelle waren alte, offen erreichbare Steuergeräte.

articles.title: John Oliver’s case against Hegseth, checked: what holds up, what’s off
articles.dek: Sunday’s Last Week Tonight called for Pete Hegseth’s impeachment. Taken claim by claim, the segment is mostly a fair summary of the reporting, with a few overstatements and two lines that are plainly wrong.

articles.title: Nvidia's board investigates Jensen Huang over an alleged Chinese spy. The real question is where the chips went
articles.dek: Huang admits an affair with a Megaspeed executive U.S. officials suspect of working for Beijing. The board, Congress and investors now want to know what, if anything, China gained.

pt.title: Conselho da Nvidia investiga Jensen Huang por suposta espiã chinesa. A questão de fundo é para onde foram os chips
pt.dek: Huang admite caso com executiva da Megaspeed que autoridades dos EUA suspeitam trabalhar para Pequim. Conselho, Congresso e investidores querem saber o que a China ganhou, se é que ganhou algo.

de.title: Nvidia-Verwaltungsrat prüft Jensen Huang wegen mutmaßlicher chinesischer Spionin. Die eigentliche Frage: Wohin gingen die Chips?
de.dek: Huang räumt eine Affäre mit einer Megaspeed-Managerin ein, die US-Behörden für eine Agentin Pekings halten. Verwaltungsrat, Kongress und Anleger wollen wissen, ob China dabei etwas gewonnen hat.

articles.title: Eisenkot gets the mandate to form Israel's government. The 67 who backed him are not a coalition
articles.dek: Israel's president hands the former army chief 28 days to build a government. His own bloc has 48 seats, the Arab-led parties he won't govern with hold 19, and the ultra-Orthodox want a draft deal.

pt.title: Eisenkot recebe o mandato para formar o governo de Israel. Os 67 que o apoiaram não são uma coalizão
pt.dek: O presidente de Israel dá ao ex-chefe do Exército 28 dias para montar um governo. O bloco dele tem 48 cadeiras, os partidos árabes com os quais ele não quer governar têm 19, e os ultraortodoxos querem um acordo sobre o alistamento.

de.title: Eisenkot erhält den Auftrag zur Regierungsbildung in Israel. Die 67, die ihn empfahlen, sind keine Koalition
de.dek: Israels Präsident gibt dem früheren Armeechef 28 Tage für eine Regierung. Sein Lager hat 48 Sitze, die arabischen Parteien, mit denen er nicht regieren will, haben 19, und die Ultraorthodoxen wollen einen Deal zur Wehrpflicht.

articles.title: Before ICE: three American mass removals, what they killed, and what the public said at the time
articles.dek: The 1930s repatriations, the wartime camps and Operation Wetback. One had a death count and a 93 percent approval rating; one had 88 dead in an afternoon and a president at 75 percent; one was never counted or polled at all. What the record says about judging the fourth.

articles.title: Deaths in custody against public approval, 2004 to 2026: the ratio no one publishes, administration by administration
articles.dek: The deadliest years in detention were under Bush, and the public never knew. The lowest approval before this year came under Biden, when the death rate was the lowest ever. For two decades approval tracked the border, not the morgue. In 2026 the lines finally point the same way, and the polls say what moved them.

articles.title: Stephen Miller’s deportation machine, by the numbers: 3,000 a day was the order. Here is what it delivered
articles.dek: Removals up by about half, a detention population that peaked at 70,766, 36 deaths in custody in one fiscal year, two U.S. citizens shot dead in Minneapolis, a department shut down, and six in ten voters saying it went too far. The ledger of the program the new chief of staff built.

articles.title: The clip that follows Stephen Miller: a Duke junior, Nancy Grace and the night two lacrosse players were arrested
articles.dek: It aired April 18, 2006. It resurfaced when he was named deputy chief of staff, again in October, and again at 4:38 Saturday morning. What was said, what the record shows about “the only Duke student,” what happened to the case, and what the people who were there say it did to him.

articles.title: Who is Stephen Miller? From a Santa Monica call-in show to the office next to the president’s, in six acts
articles.dek: He is 41, has worked for Trump longer than anyone in the building, and has written the administration’s immigration policy twice. The record he made himself, from the Larry Elder Show at 16 to the 3,000-a-day order, and what is on his desk Monday.

articles.title: Three days after losing Congress, Trump hands the White House to Stephen Miller. The plan for it was already written
articles.dek: Susie Wiles resigned Thursday night; Miller takes over Monday. He has spent the past seven months with Russ Vought cataloguing what the president can do without Congress, and the Democrats who take Congress in January say they will start with him.

articles.title: Ilse Aigner is set to become Germany's first woman president. Here is how she got there
articles.dek: Merz's CDU has come round to the CSU's candidate after weeks of tension. The coalition has the votes for January 30; the fight was over who decides.

pt.title: Ilse Aigner deve se tornar a primeira mulher presidente da Alemanha. Veja como ela chegou lá
pt.dek: A CDU de Merz cedeu à candidata da CSU após semanas de tensão. A coalizão tem os votos para 30 de janeiro; a disputa foi sobre quem decide.

de.title: Ilse Aigner soll Deutschlands erste Bundespräsidentin werden. So kam es dazu
de.dek: Die CDU von Merz hat nach wochenlangen Spannungen die Kandidatin der CSU akzeptiert. Die Koalition hat die Stimmen für den 30. Januar; gestritten wurde darüber, wer entscheidet.

articles.title: The Simpsons called President Trump in 2000. The same episode says a woman is next, and the market has a name for her
articles.dek: “Bart to the Future” gave Lisa Simpson the Oval Office and a budget crunch inherited from President Trump. Half of the joke came true. The other half now trades on Kalshi at about 10 cents on the dollar, under the name Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.

articles.title: “How bad is it?” “We're broke.” The budget crunch the next president actually inherits
articles.dek: In the 2000 episode, President Lisa Simpson's first question is about the money Trump left behind. The real answer in 2026: a $1.99 trillion deficit, more than $1 trillion a year in interest, a gross debt past $40 trillion. What is on the desk on Jan. 20, 2029, and how much of it carries this administration's name.

articles.title: Ten cents on the prophecy: the market's likeliest woman to follow Trump promised an answer after the midterms
articles.dek: Kalshi prices Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez at 10 percent to win in 2028 and 14 percent to be the Democratic nominee, behind Jon Ossoff on both boards and far ahead of every other woman. She said she would decide after the midterms. They were Tuesday. What the board says, how it got there, and what she has said.

articles.title: Paraguay's Ueno Bank collapse: frozen savings, jailed bankers and a president who tried to quit
articles.dek: A bank serving about 3 million Paraguayans failed in days, trapping pension and dam money. Santiago Peña offered his resignation; Congress impeached him instead. What happened, who gets paid, and what comes next.

pt.title: Quebra do Ueno Bank no Paraguai: poupanças congeladas, banqueiros presos e um presidente que tentou renunciar
pt.dek: Um banco com cerca de 3 milhões de clientes paraguaios quebrou em dias e prendeu dinheiro da previdência e das hidrelétricas. Santiago Peña ofereceu a renúncia; o Congresso abriu impeachment. O que aconteceu, quem recebe e o que vem agora.

de.title: Zusammenbruch der Ueno Bank in Paraguay: eingefrorene Ersparnisse, inhaftierte Banker und ein Präsident, der gehen wollte
de.dek: Eine Bank mit rund 3 Millionen Kunden in Paraguay brach binnen Tagen zusammen, mit Renten- und Kraftwerksgeldern. Santiago Peña bot seinen Rücktritt an, der Kongress leitete die Amtsenthebung ein. Was geschah, wer Geld bekommt, wie es weitergeht.

articles.title: How Thomas Massie gets his vote to impeach Pete Hegseth, and how it plays out from there
articles.dek: The Kentucky Republican, in his last weeks in Congress, says he will force the vote when the House returns next week unless the defense secretary resigns. The floor math, the three ways the House can answer, the Senate’s options and the dates to watch.

pt.title: Como Thomas Massie consegue sua votação pelo impeachment de Pete Hegseth, e o que acontece a partir daí
pt.dek: O republicano do Kentucky, em suas últimas semanas no Congresso, diz que forçará a votação quando a Câmara voltar, na próxima semana, a menos que o secretário de Defesa renuncie. A matemática do plenário, as três respostas possíveis da Câmara, as opções do Senado e as datas a acompanhar.

de.title: Wie Thomas Massie zu seiner Abstimmung über ein Impeachment von Pete Hegseth kommt – und wie es danach weitergeht
de.dek: Der Republikaner aus Kentucky, in seinen letzten Wochen im Kongress, sagt, er werde die Abstimmung erzwingen, wenn das Repräsentantenhaus nächste Woche zurückkehrt, sofern der Verteidigungsminister nicht zurücktritt. Die Mehrheitsrechnung, die drei möglichen Antworten des Hauses, die Optionen des Senats und die wichtigen Termine.

articles.title: The Republican blame game: Vance says the war, Trump says Fox News and gas prices, and many point at Hegseth
articles.dek: A day after losing both chambers, Republicans had at least five explanations and one name. Who is blaming whom, what each account leaves out, and why the defense secretary is the one answer with a vote attached.

pt.title: O jogo de culpas republicano: Vance aponta a guerra, Trump culpa a Fox News e o preço da gasolina, e muitos apontam para Hegseth
pt.dek: Um dia depois de perder as duas Casas do Congresso, os republicanos tinham ao menos cinco explicações e um nome. Quem culpa quem, o que cada versão deixa de fora e por que o secretário de Defesa é a única resposta que vem acompanhada de uma votação.

de.title: Schuldzuweisungen bei den Republikanern: Vance nennt den Krieg, Trump Fox News und den Benzinpreis – und viele zeigen auf Hegseth
de.dek: Einen Tag nach dem Verlust beider Kammern hatten die Republikaner mindestens fünf Erklärungen und einen Namen. Wer wem die Schuld gibt, was jede Darstellung auslässt und warum der Verteidigungsminister die einzige Antwort ist, an der eine Abstimmung hängt.

articles.title: The eight articles: what Massie’s resolution accuses Pete Hegseth of, and how the Pentagon answers
articles.dek: Half the charges concern the Iran war. The rest reach back to boat strikes, a senator’s censure, the Maduro raid and Yemen. A charge-by-charge reading of the 34 pages the House may vote on next week.

pt.title: Os oito artigos: do que a resolução de Massie acusa Pete Hegseth e como o Pentágono responde
pt.dek: Metade das acusações diz respeito à guerra contra o Irã. As demais remontam a ataques a embarcações, à carta de censura a um senador, à incursão contra Maduro e ao Iêmen. Uma leitura, acusação por acusação, das 34 páginas que a Câmara pode votar na próxima semana.

de.title: Die acht Anklagepunkte: Was Massies Resolution Pete Hegseth vorwirft – und wie das Pentagon antwortet
de.dek: Die Hälfte der Vorwürfe betrifft den Irankrieg. Die übrigen reichen zurück zu Angriffen auf Boote, der Rüge eines Senators, der Kommandoaktion gegen Maduro und dem Jemen. Die 34 Seiten, über die das Repräsentantenhaus nächste Woche abstimmen könnte, Anklagepunkt für Anklagepunkt gelesen.

articles.title: Belknap, Mayorkas, Hegseth: what the only two cabinet impeachments say about a Senate trial
articles.dek: One secretary resigned minutes before the House voted and was tried anyway. The other was impeached by one vote and never tried at all. Both precedents now bear on what the Senate could do with Pete Hegseth.

pt.title: Belknap, Mayorkas, Hegseth: o que os dois únicos impeachments de secretários do gabinete dizem sobre um julgamento no Senado
pt.dek: Um secretário renunciou minutos antes de a Câmara votar e foi julgado mesmo assim. O outro sofreu impeachment por um voto de diferença e nunca chegou a ser julgado. Os dois precedentes pesam agora sobre o que o Senado poderia fazer com Pete Hegseth.

de.title: Belknap, Mayorkas, Hegseth: Was die beiden einzigen Impeachments gegen Minister über einen Prozess im Senat aussagen
de.dek: Der eine Minister trat Minuten vor der Abstimmung im Repräsentantenhaus zurück, und ihm wurde trotzdem der Prozess gemacht. Gegen den anderen wurde mit einer Stimme Mehrheit Anklage erhoben, zu einem Prozess kam es nie. Beide Präzedenzfälle sind nun dafür von Bedeutung, was der Senat mit Pete Hegseth tun könnte.

articles.title: Joshua Wong gets 10 more years for foreign collusion, weeks before he was due to go free
articles.dek: Hong Kong's best-known democracy activist was sentenced under the national security law over a campaign for foreign sanctions. What he admitted, how the court reasoned, and what each side says.

pt.title: Joshua Wong pega mais dez anos de prisão por conluio estrangeiro, semanas antes de ser libertado
pt.dek: O ativista pró-democracia mais conhecido de Hong Kong foi condenado com base na lei de segurança nacional por uma campanha por sanções estrangeiras. O que ele admitiu, como o tribunal decidiu e o que diz cada lado.

de.title: Joshua Wong muss zehn weitere Jahre in Haft – wenige Wochen vor seiner geplanten Freilassung
de.dek: Hongkongs bekanntester Demokratieaktivist wurde nach dem Sicherheitsgesetz wegen einer Kampagne für ausländische Sanktionen verurteilt. Was er eingeräumt hat, wie das Gericht argumentierte und was die Seiten sagen.

articles.title: Fact check: the viral reel pitting $23 billion in student debt against the Iran war gets the numbers mixed up
articles.dek: The $23 billion is real but was never blocked. The plan Republicans did stop was about $430 billion, and the Supreme Court killed it on legal grounds, not cost. The war has cost more than $40 billion, and Hormuz is still far from open.

articles.title: Democrats take Congress in a midterm rout on Republican ground, ending Trump's grip on Washington
articles.dek: Wins in Texas, Kansas, Maine and South Carolina handed Democrats the Senate as they retook the House. Here is how it happened, why voters moved, and what divided government means from January.

pt.title: Democratas tomam o Congresso numa derrota republicana em território conservador e acabam com o domínio de Trump em Washington
pt.dek: Vitórias no Texas, no Kansas, no Maine e na Carolina do Sul deram o Senado aos democratas, que também retomaram a Câmara. Como isso aconteceu, por que os eleitores mudaram e o que o governo dividido significa a partir de janeiro.

de.title: Demokraten erobern den Kongress mit Siegen auf republikanischem Terrain und brechen Trumps Griff auf Washington
de.dek: Siege in Texas, Kansas, Maine und South Carolina brachten den Demokraten den Senat, dazu holten sie das Repräsentantenhaus zurück. Wie es dazu kam, warum die Wähler umschwenkten und was die geteilte Macht ab Januar bedeutet.

articles.title: A bombed aid hub, an expired truce and new talks: Ukraine's war in 48 hours
articles.dek: Russian guided bombs killed at least 26 people at an aid point in Zaporizhzhia a day after the war's longest truce ended, as Washington set Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi for November 10 and 11.

pt.title: Um posto de ajuda bombardeado, uma trégua expirada e novas negociações: a guerra na Ucrânia em 48 horas
pt.dek: Bombas guiadas russas mataram pelo menos 26 pessoas num ponto de distribuição de ajuda em Zaporíjia um dia após o fim da trégua mais longa da guerra, enquanto Washington marcou negociações entre Ucrânia e Rússia em Abu Dhabi para 10 e 11 de novembro.

de.title: Eine bombardierte Hilfsstelle, eine abgelaufene Waffenruhe und neue Gespräche: der Ukraine-Krieg in 48 Stunden
de.dek: Russische Gleitbomben töteten an einer Hilfsgüterausgabe in Saporischschja mindestens 26 Menschen, einen Tag nach dem Ende der längsten Waffenruhe des Krieges. Washington setzte Gespräche zwischen der Ukraine und Russland in Abu Dhabi für den 10. und 11. November an.

articles.title: Arrested at his green card interview over a notice sent to the wrong address, a Canadian dentist is freed by a federal judge
articles.dek: Judge Michael Davis ruled ICE's arrest of William Lizardo violated the Fourth and Fifth Amendments, faulting the government for conceding its own mistake while fighting to keep him locked up.

articles.title: Without a campus polling site, Greensboro students marched 45 minutes to vote. Here’s how it came to that
articles.dek: Video of NC A&T and UNCG students walking to Union Square has gone viral on the eve of Election Day. Behind it: a party-line fight over early voting sites that ran from the county board to the state board to federal court.

articles.title: Trump Jr. warns Democrats want to “make Ohio a state” on the eve of a tight Ohio vote
articles.dek: Closing out the GOP campaign near Toledo, Donald Trump Jr. slipped while reaching for the party’s line on D.C. statehood. The clip spread within the hour. Ohio, a state since 1803, votes Tuesday in two races rated close.

articles.title: Iran and the US brace for a second round as Hormuz burns and talks in Doha race the midterm clock
articles.dek: Tehran warns a renewed war could outlast the first, Trump says one or two targets remain, and tankers keep getting hit in the strait. What each side wants, and what to watch after Tuesday's vote.

pt.title: Irã e EUA se preparam para um segundo round enquanto Ormuz arde e negociações em Doha correm contra o relógio das eleições
pt.dek: Teerã avisa que uma nova guerra pode durar mais que a primeira, Trump diz que restam um ou dois alvos e petroleiros continuam sendo atingidos no estreito. O que cada lado quer e o que observar depois da votação de terça.

de.title: Iran und die USA rüsten für eine zweite Runde – während Hormus brennt und die Gespräche in Doha gegen die Uhr der Midterms laufen
de.dek: Teheran warnt, ein neuer Krieg könnte länger dauern als der erste, Trump sagt, ein oder zwei Ziele seien noch übrig, und in der Meerenge werden weiter Tanker getroffen. Was jede Seite will und worauf es nach der Wahl am Dienstag ankommt.

articles.title: Lindsey Graham's legacy on the ballot: a shelved bribery probe, the Iran war, and his sister's race
articles.dek: ProPublica says an FBI inquiry centered on Graham's $40,000 steak dinner stalled after the bureau's purge. He also helped talk Trump into war with Iran. On Tuesday, voters decide whether his sister keeps his seat.

articles.title: How Flávio Bolsonaro left Brazil despite a court ban, and why three governments are now explaining it
articles.dek: A week after losing to Lula, the senator is in Florida. Brazil is investigating his night crossing into Argentina, Washington denies helping him, and Trump says he can stay.

pt.title: Como Flávio Bolsonaro deixou o Brasil apesar da proibição judicial, e por que três governos agora tentam explicar
pt.dek: Uma semana depois de perder para Lula, o senador está na Flórida. O Brasil investiga sua travessia noturna para a Argentina, Washington nega ter ajudado e Trump diz que ele pode ficar.

de.title: Wie Flávio Bolsonaro trotz Ausreiseverbot Brasilien verließ und warum drei Regierungen nun Erklärungen liefern
de.dek: Eine Woche nach seiner Niederlage gegen Lula ist der Senator in Florida. Brasilien ermittelt zu seinem nächtlichen Grenzübertritt nach Argentinien, Washington bestreitet jede Hilfe, und Trump sagt, er könne bleiben.

articles.title: Hundreds charged with assaulting or impeding immigration agents. Nearly half the cases that ended were lost or abandoned.
articles.dek: The Times counted 558 people charged under 18 U.S.C. § 111, and 213 cases dismissed or acquitted. Three months on, Reuters and the AP have found the same pattern, judges have found agents’ accounts contradicted by video, and DHS says assaults are up 1,600 percent. The record, and what the government says.

pt.title: Centenas foram acusados de agredir ou obstruir agentes de imigração. Quase metade dos casos encerrados foi perdida ou abandonada.
pt.dek: O Times contou 558 pessoas acusadas sob o 18 U.S.C. § 111 e 213 casos arquivados ou com absolvição. Três meses depois, Reuters e AP encontraram o mesmo padrão, juízes viram relatos de agentes contraditos por vídeo, e o DHS diz que as agressões subiram 1.600 por cento. O histórico, e o que diz o governo.

de.title: Hunderte angeklagt, Einwanderungsbeamte angegriffen oder behindert zu haben. Fast die Hälfte der beendeten Fälle verloren oder aufgegeben.
de.dek: Die Times zählte 558 Angeklagte nach 18 U.S.C. § 111 und 213 eingestellte oder mit Freispruch beendete Verfahren. Drei Monate später finden Reuters und die AP dasselbe Muster, Richter sehen Beamtenaussagen durch Videos widerlegt, und das DHS meldet 1.600 Prozent mehr Angriffe. Die Bilanz – und was die Regierung sagt.

articles.title: One Arlington office building, $1.3 billion in DHS deals: the companies around William Walters
articles.dek: A former State Department surgeon with no federal contracting record sits behind the self-deportation program, the $464 million aircraft fleet and the jet that flew Kristi Noem to Jordan. A contracting officer saw the appearance of favoritism; the deals went through anyway. Now the Justice Department is looking.

pt.title: Um prédio de escritórios em Arlington, US$ 1,3 bilhão em negócios com o DHS: as empresas em torno de William Walters
pt.dek: Um ex-cirurgião do Departamento de Estado sem histórico de contratos federais está por trás do programa de autodeportação, da frota de aviões de US$ 464 milhões e do jato que levou Kristi Noem à Jordânia. Um agente de contratações viu aparência de favorecimento; os negócios foram adiante mesmo assim. Agora o Departamento de Justiça está de olho.

de.title: Ein Bürogebäude in Arlington, 1,3 Milliarden Dollar an DHS-Aufträgen: die Firmen um William Walters
de.dek: Ein ehemaliger Chirurg des US-Außenministeriums ohne Erfahrung mit Bundesaufträgen steht hinter dem Selbstabschiebungsprogramm, der 464 Millionen Dollar teuren Flugzeugflotte und dem Jet, der Kristi Noem nach Jordanien flog. Ein Vergabebeamter sah den Anschein von Begünstigung; die Geschäfte gingen trotzdem durch. Jetzt prüft das Justizministerium.

articles.title: DHS paid $464 million for ten planes it could not fly. The last five were bought on Noem's final morning, at a markup.
articles.dek: A no-bid deal justified by urgency produced seven jets parked in Louisiana without crews, a private 737 nobody will take and a Gulfstream for the FBI director. The first deportation flights came this week, eleven months in, with senators' questions unanswered and a criminal inquiry circling the department's contracts.

pt.title: DHS pagou US$ 464 milhões por dez aviões que não conseguia operar. Os últimos cinco foram comprados na última manhã de Noem no cargo, com sobrepreço.
pt.dek: Um contrato sem licitação, justificado pela urgência, rendeu sete jatos parados na Louisiana sem tripulação, um 737 privado que ninguém quer e um Gulfstream para o diretor do FBI. Os primeiros voos de deportação só vieram nesta semana, onze meses depois, com senadores sem resposta e uma investigação criminal rondando os contratos do órgão.

de.title: Das DHS zahlte 464 Millionen Dollar für zehn Flugzeuge, die es nicht fliegen konnte. Die letzten fünf wurden an Noems letztem Morgen im Amt gekauft – mit Aufschlag.
de.dek: Ein ohne Ausschreibung vergebener, mit Dringlichkeit begründeter Auftrag: sieben Jets ohne Besatzung in Louisiana, eine Privat-737, die niemand will, ein Gulfstream für den FBI-Direktor. Die ersten Abschiebeflüge kamen diese Woche, nach elf Monaten – Fragen von Senatoren sind offen, strafrechtliche Ermittlungen umkreisen die Aufträge des Ministeriums.

articles.title: The fraud hunters' ledger: two dead citizens, no fraud arrests from the surge, and a $420 million markup on a prison
articles.dek: Analysis. The administration justified flooding Minneapolis with federal agents by pointing at Minnesota's fraud scandals. Ten months on, the surge's arrest data, the evidence still withheld in two killings and ICE's own real estate record show who was watching whom.

articles.title: ICE paid $495.6 million for an empty Minnesota prison. The state had been offered it for $75 million.
articles.dek: CoreCivic's shuttered Appleton facility is assessed at $14.75 million. The sale closed the day it was signed, the company bought back $500 million of its own stock six days later, and the Treasury secretary, in Minnesota to announce a fraud crackdown, called the question a waste of time.

articles.title: The building behind the joke: what the White House ballroom costs, who is paying, and who said it could go ahead
articles.dek: The Cheesecake Factory line landed because the project it mocked is real and unresolved: an East Wing demolished, a price that has tripled, donors with business before the government, and a Supreme Court that let the work continue without saying whether it is legal. The facts, with each side's figures.

pt.title: O prédio por trás da piada: quanto custa o salão de baile da Casa Branca, quem está pagando e quem disse que a obra podia seguir
pt.dek: A frase da Cheesecake Factory pegou porque o projeto que ela zombava é real e está em aberto: uma Ala Leste demolida, um preço que triplicou, doadores com negócios diante do governo e uma Suprema Corte que deixou a obra continuar sem dizer se ela é legal. Os fatos, com os números de cada lado.

de.title: Das Gebäude hinter dem Witz: Was der Ballsaal des Weißen Hauses kostet, wer bezahlt und wer sagte, dass gebaut werden darf
de.dek: Die Cheesecake-Factory-Pointe traf, weil das verspottete Projekt real und ungeklärt ist: ein abgerissener Ostflügel, ein Preis, der sich verdreifacht hat, Spender mit Geschäften bei der Regierung und ein Supreme Court, der weiterbauen ließ, ohne zu sagen, ob das rechtmäßig ist. Die Fakten, mit den Zahlen jeder Seite.

articles.title: A one-liner and a whole-of-government response: how the Cheesecake Factory became the midterms' closing argument
articles.dek: Barack Obama said Trump's gilded White House looked like Saddam Hussein had opened a Cheesecake Factory. Four days, one Treasury secretary's dinner and a record quarter later, he was back on stage in Georgia explaining why the response proved his point. What was said, by whom, and why both sides wanted the fight.

pt.title: Uma piada e uma resposta de “todo o governo”: como a Cheesecake Factory virou o argumento final das eleições de meio de mandato
pt.dek: Barack Obama disse que a Casa Branca dourada de Trump parecia uma Cheesecake Factory aberta por Saddam Hussein. Quatro dias, um jantar do secretário do Tesouro e um trimestre recorde depois, ele voltou ao palco na Geórgia para explicar por que a reação provava o que ele dizia. O que foi dito, por quem, e por que os dois lados queriam a briga.

de.title: Ein Einzeiler und eine Antwort „der gesamten Regierung“: Wie die Cheesecake Factory zum Schlussargument der Zwischenwahlen wurde
de.dek: Barack Obama sagte, Trumps vergoldetes Weißes Haus sehe aus, als hätte Saddam Hussein eine Cheesecake Factory eröffnet. Vier Tage, ein Abendessen des Finanzministers und ein Rekordquartal später stand er in Georgia wieder auf der Bühne und erklärte, warum die Reaktion ihm recht gebe. Was gesagt wurde, von wem, und warum beide Seiten den Streit wollten.

articles.title: Poland's constitutional court standoff: police, a suspended chief justice and a president who flew home
articles.dek: Government-backed judges moved to suspend the head of Poland's Constitutional Tribunal, and President Nawrocki rushed back from Senegal to oppose them. Here is how a ten-year dispute reached this point, what each side argues, and what comes next.

pt.title: O impasse no tribunal constitucional da Polônia: polícia, um presidente da corte suspenso e um chefe de Estado que voltou às pressas
pt.dek: Juízes apoiados pelo governo tentaram suspender o presidente do Tribunal Constitucional da Polônia, e o presidente Nawrocki voltou do Senegal para se opor. Como uma disputa de dez anos chegou a esse ponto, o que cada lado argumenta e o que vem a seguir.

de.title: Machtkampf um Polens Verfassungsgericht: Polizei, ein suspendierter Gerichtspräsident und ein Staatschef, der umkehrte
de.dek: Regierungsnahe Richter wollen den Präsidenten des polnischen Verfassungsgerichts suspendieren, Präsident Nawrocki eilte aus dem Senegal zurück, um sich ihnen entgegenzustellen. Wie ein zehnjähriger Streit so weit kam, was beide Seiten sagen und wie es weitergeht.

articles.title: Binance loses $6.3 billion in the largest crypto theft on record, and analysts point to North Korea
articles.dek: An attacker drained hot wallets on ten blockchains in minutes. About $3 billion has been frozen, Binance promises to cover every loss, and billions remain out of reach.

pt.title: Binance perde US$ 6,3 bilhões no maior roubo de criptomoedas já registrado, e analistas apontam para a Coreia do Norte
pt.dek: Um invasor drenou carteiras em dez blockchains em minutos. Cerca de US$ 3 bilhões foram congelados, a Binance promete cobrir todas as perdas e bilhões seguem fora de alcance.

de.title: Binance verliert 6,3 Milliarden Dollar beim größten Kryptodiebstahl aller Zeiten – Analysten verdächtigen Nordkorea
de.dek: Ein Angreifer leerte binnen Minuten Wallets auf zehn Blockchains. Rund 3 Milliarden Dollar sind eingefroren, Binance will alle Verluste ersetzen, doch Milliarden bleiben unerreichbar.

articles.title: RFK Jr. opens the door to six unapproved peptides, overriding FDA scientists
articles.dek: HHS will let compounding pharmacies make BPC-157 and five other wellness peptides while the FDA writes rules. Supporters call it harm reduction; the agency's reviewers say the drugs remain unproven.

pt.title: RFK Jr. abre caminho para seis peptídeos não aprovados, contrariando cientistas da FDA
pt.dek: O HHS vai permitir que farmácias de manipulação produzam BPC-157 e outros cinco peptídeos de bem-estar enquanto a FDA elabora regras. Defensores falam em redução de danos; os técnicos da agência dizem que os produtos seguem sem comprovação.

de.title: RFK Jr. öffnet die Tür für sechs nicht zugelassene Peptide – gegen den Rat der FDA-Wissenschaftler
de.dek: Das HHS erlaubt Rezepturapotheken, BPC-157 und fünf weitere Wellness-Peptide herzustellen, während die FDA Regeln ausarbeitet. Befürworter sprechen von Schadensminderung, die Gutachter der Behörde halten die Mittel für unbewiesen.

articles.title: Trump moves to loosen methane rules for oil and gas, reopening a decade-long fight
articles.dek: The EPA plans to scrap its satellite-based super-emitter program and ease standards for low-producing wells. Here is what would change, what each side's numbers show, and what comes next.

pt.title: Trump afrouxa regras de metano para petróleo e gás e reabre uma briga de uma década
pt.dek: A EPA quer acabar com o programa de detecção de superemissores por satélite e aliviar as exigências para poços de baixa produção. O que mudaria, o que mostram os números de cada lado e o que vem a seguir.

de.title: Trump will Methan-Regeln für Öl und Gas lockern und eröffnet einen jahrzehntelangen Streit neu
de.dek: Die US-Umweltbehörde EPA will ihr satellitengestütztes Programm gegen Großemittenten abschaffen und die Vorgaben für förderschwache Bohrungen lockern. Was sich ändern würde, was die Zahlen beider Seiten zeigen und wie es weitergeht.

articles.title: Israel votes in its first election since October 7, with polls pointing to deadlock
articles.dek: Benjamin Netanyahu is fighting for a seventh term against former army chief Gadi Eisenkot. Final polls give neither bloc a majority, leaving small parties, the Arab vote and weeks of coalition talks to decide who governs.

pt.title: Israel vai às urnas pela primeira vez desde o 7 de outubro, com pesquisas indicando impasse
pt.dek: Benjamin Netanyahu disputa um sétimo mandato contra o ex-chefe do Exército Gadi Eisenkot. As últimas pesquisas não dão maioria a nenhum bloco, e partidos pequenos, o voto árabe e semanas de negociação devem decidir quem governa.

de.title: Israel wählt zum ersten Mal seit dem 7. Oktober, die Umfragen deuten auf ein Patt
de.dek: Benjamin Netanjahu kämpft gegen den früheren Armeechef Gadi Eisenkot um eine siebte Amtszeit. Die letzten Umfragen sehen keinen Block bei einer Mehrheit; kleine Parteien, die arabischen Stimmen und wochenlange Koalitionsgespräche dürften entscheiden.

articles.title: Serbia's students defeat Vučić at the ballot box, ending 14 years of Progressive Party rule
articles.dek: A movement born from the Novi Sad canopy collapse won a parliamentary majority on record turnout. Here is how it happened, what each side says, and what it means for Serbia's EU bid and its ties to Russia.

pt.title: Estudantes derrotam Vučić nas urnas e encerram 14 anos de governo do Partido Progressista na Sérvia
pt.dek: Um movimento nascido do desabamento da marquise de Novi Sad conquistou a maioria no Parlamento com comparecimento recorde. Veja como isso aconteceu, o que diz cada lado e o que muda para a candidatura da Sérvia à UE e seus laços com a Rússia.

de.title: Serbiens Studenten schlagen Vučić an der Wahlurne und beenden 14 Jahre Herrschaft der Fortschrittspartei
de.dek: Eine Bewegung, die aus dem Einsturz des Vordachs in Novi Sad entstand, hat bei Rekordbeteiligung die Mehrheit im Parlament gewonnen. Wie es dazu kam, was beide Seiten sagen und was das für Serbiens EU-Kurs und seine Nähe zu Russland bedeutet.

articles.title: How Brazil's polls and prediction markets missed Lula's comeback
articles.dek: The final polls had Flávio Bolsonaro ahead 51 to 49 and bettors gave him 80%. Lula won by 3.6 points, on a turnout surge the polls' models didn't price.

pt.title: Como as pesquisas e os mercados de previsão erraram a virada de Lula
pt.dek: As últimas pesquisas davam Flávio Bolsonaro à frente por 51% a 49%, e os apostadores lhe atribuíam 80% de chance. Lula venceu por 3,6 pontos, impulsionado por uma alta do comparecimento que os modelos dos institutos não precificaram.

de.title: Wie Brasiliens Umfragen und Prognosemärkte Lulas Comeback übersahen
de.dek: Die letzten Umfragen sahen Flávio Bolsonaro mit 51 zu 49 vorn, Wettende gaben ihm 80 Prozent. Lula gewann mit 3,6 Punkten Vorsprung – getragen von einer höheren Wahlbeteiligung, die die Modelle der Institute nicht eingepreist hatten.

articles.title: France's protests collide with a debt squeeze, as the budget fight returns to parliament
articles.dek: Nearly 1,000 arrests followed another Saturday of mass marches. The students' demands cost money that a government with record borrowing costs and no majority says it does not have.

pt.title: Protestos na França esbarram no aperto da dívida, e a briga do Orçamento volta ao Parlamento
pt.dek: Quase mil presos depois de mais um sábado de passeatas em massa. As reivindicações dos estudantes custam um dinheiro que um governo sem maioria e com juros recordes diz não ter.

de.title: Frankreichs Proteste treffen auf die Schuldenklemme, und der Haushaltsstreit kehrt ins Parlament zurück
de.dek: Fast 1.000 Festnahmen nach einem weiteren Samstag mit Massenprotesten. Die Forderungen der Schüler kosten Geld, das eine Regierung ohne Mehrheit und mit Rekord-Finanzierungskosten nach eigenen Worten nicht hat.

articles.title: What remains open in the Epstein case: the appeals, lawsuits and investigations to watch
articles.dek: A federal appeal over redactions, a new New Mexico lawsuit against the men who ran Epstein's money, two British police inquiries and a stalled bill in Congress: where each open thread stands and what comes next.

pt.title: O que continua em aberto no caso Epstein: os recursos, processos e investigações a acompanhar
pt.dek: Um recurso federal sobre tarjas, um novo processo do Novo México contra os homens que administravam o dinheiro de Epstein, duas investigações da polícia britânica e um projeto parado no Congresso: em que pé está cada frente e o que vem a seguir.

de.title: Was im Fall Epstein offen ist: die Berufungen, Klagen und Ermittlungen, auf die es ankommt
de.dek: Eine Berufung um Schwärzungen, eine neue Klage New Mexicos gegen die Verwalter von Epsteins Geld, zwei britische Polizeiermittlungen und ein festgefahrenes Gesetz im Kongress: Wo jeder offene Strang steht und was als Nächstes kommt.

articles.title: Follow the money: what regulators, courts and the Senate found about Epstein's banks
articles.dek: Banks and Epstein's estate have paid about $900 million to settle Epstein-related suits. Regulators' orders, court settlements and a Senate report show what the banks saw and when, and the released files add Epstein's own account.

pt.title: Siga o dinheiro: o que reguladores, tribunais e o Senado descobriram sobre os bancos de Epstein
pt.dek: Bancos e o espólio de Epstein pagaram cerca de US$ 900 milhões em acordos. Ordens de reguladores, acordos judiciais e um relatório do Senado mostram o que os bancos viram e quando, e os arquivos divulgados acrescentam a versão do próprio Epstein.

de.title: Der Spur des Geldes folgen: Was Aufsicht, Gerichte und Senat über Epsteins Banken herausfanden
de.dek: Banken und Epsteins Nachlass haben rund 900 Millionen Dollar in Vergleichen gezahlt. Behördliche Anordnungen, Gerichtsvergleiche und ein Senatsbericht zeigen, was die Banken wann sahen, und die veröffentlichten Akten liefern Epsteins eigene Sicht.

articles.title: How the Epstein files came out, and what the government is still holding back
articles.dek: A law passed almost unanimously ordered the Justice Department to publish its Epstein files in 30 days. Eleven months and 3.5 million pages later, a judge, an inspector general and Congress are still arguing over what is missing.

pt.title: Como os arquivos de Epstein vieram a público e o que o governo ainda retém
pt.dek: Uma lei aprovada quase por unanimidade mandou o Departamento de Justiça publicar seus arquivos sobre Epstein em 30 dias. Onze meses e 3,5 milhões de páginas depois, um juiz, um inspetor-geral e o Congresso ainda discutem o que falta.

de.title: Wie die Epstein-Akten ans Licht kamen und was die Regierung noch zurückhält
de.dek: Ein fast einstimmig beschlossenes Gesetz verpflichtete das Justizministerium, seine Epstein-Akten binnen 30 Tagen zu veröffentlichen. Elf Monate und 3,5 Millionen Seiten später streiten ein Richter, ein Generalinspekteur und der Kongress noch immer darüber, was fehlt.

articles.title: Brazil votes in a dead heat as Lula faces a Bolsonaro again, this time the son
articles.dek: Final polls put Senator Flávio Bolsonaro a point ahead of President Lula, inside the margin of error, before Sunday's runoff. Here is how the race got here, what each side argues, what is at stake for the economy, and the American role.

pt.title: Brasil vota em empate técnico, e Lula enfrenta de novo um Bolsonaro, agora o filho
pt.dek: Últimas pesquisas mostram o senador Flávio Bolsonaro um ponto à frente do presidente Lula, dentro da margem de erro, às vésperas do segundo turno de domingo. Veja como a disputa chegou até aqui, o que cada lado defende, o que está em jogo para a economia e o papel dos Estados Unidos.

de.title: Kopf-an-Kopf-Rennen in Brasilien: Lula trifft erneut auf einen Bolsonaro – diesmal auf den Sohn
de.dek: Die letzten Umfragen sehen Senator Flávio Bolsonaro vor der Stichwahl am Sonntag einen Punkt vor Präsident Lula – innerhalb der Fehlertoleranz. Wie es zu diesem Duell kam, womit beide Lager werben, was für die Wirtschaft auf dem Spiel steht und welche Rolle die USA spielen.
